description: This file defines a Razor TagHelper class 'StyleTagHelper' for managing stylesheet resources in an ASP.NET Core project. It handles different scenarios for including styles via URLs, resource names, inline content, and dependencies, integrating with a resource management system.

classes.name: StyleTagHelper
classes.description: A TagHelper for managing stylesheet resources, supporting URL-based, named, inline, and custom style inclusion with dependency and environment considerations.

methods.name: ProcessAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously processes the TagHelper to generate appropriate style resource inclusion based on provided attributes and content.
